title: Algebraic derivations and radicals of automorphism groups of algebras
summary: The paper "Algebraic derivations and radicals of automorphism groups of algebras" continues both the well-known line of description of algebraic derivations of semiprime associative algebras in terms of inner derivations of their symmetric Martindale rings of quotients, and results on the coincidence of the prime and weakly solvable radicals of subgroups of multiplicative groups of PI-rings using the example of automorphism groups of algebras associated with their algebraic derivations.
